newsitem.title: USA: Clinton would like to visit India next year.
newsitem.headline: Clinton would like to visit India next year.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton would like to make a trip to South Asia next year, including a visit to India, the White House said on Monday.
Spokeswoman Anne Luzzatto said Clinton had been invited to India to celebrate its 50th anniversary of independence and wanted to go.
"The president has indicated he would very much like to visit South Asia and we are looking at the possibilities of such a trip," Luzzatto said.
She did not say what other countries might be included on the trip.

In New Delhi, Indian Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral said Clinton had accepted his invitation to visit India during year-long celebrations following the 50th independence anniversary, which falls this Aug. 15.
Jimmy Carter, who visited India in early January 1978, was the last U.S. president to go there.
